title: Meet Ken Schreiber, retired pilot who donated $400,000 to save Neil Armstrong's childhood home
summary_full: Ken Schreiber has made a generous donation of $400,000 with the aim of preserving Neil Armstrong's childhood home, highlighting its important place in history. The Auglaize County Historical Society plans to restore the house to its original 1940s charm, inspired by Schreiber's deep admiration for Armstrong. Scheduled for public tours by 2030, this initiative ensures that future generations can appreciate the legacy of the first man on the moon.
